thresholds.basis: Practical screening rule, not a statistical significance test. Traffic means sessions for channel comparisons, active users for user comparisons.

rate_basis: Browser, device, OS, model and city rates: active users in the purchase-event-only report divided by all active users for the same dimension value and dates. Channels: native GA4 session purchase rate. Do not compare these two rate units directly.
buyer_basis: An observed GA4 user who triggered purchase; not a verified Salla paid customer.
city_scope: All 226 city rows, location inferred by GA4; not a shipping-address breakdown.
model_scope: All 126 model rows; many devices have a generic iPhone label.
